description: This source file contains a function to create an XML data model structure for a specific test server setup. It involves creating XML nodes such as version, moduleName, author, description, library, objects, and parameters, with some parameters like ParamString and ParamInteger. The function constructs and returns a hierarchical XML node object representing the data model.

methods.name: PVOID DMPackCreateDataModelXML()
methods.description: Creates and initializes an XML data model object with specific nodes and parameters for use in the MsgBusTestServer.
